overview: West Kelowna had 36,078 residents in the 2021 Census, up 10.5 percent from 32,655 in 2016, in 13,975 occupied homes across 122.09 square kilometres. Steady growth brings new households that are still choosing local providers.
The economy mixes wineries and tourism, lumber manufacturing, construction and retail. Kelowna sits just across the bridge, so local businesses must give people clear reasons to stay on the Westside.
